cues: While assembling a bookshelf, she turns a slotted fastener until the wooden panels sit flush.
A repairer opens the battery compartment by rotating its tiny captive fastener beneath the remote’s cover.
At the workbench, he secures a loose cabinet hinge by turning two small fasteners into the door.
Cloud shadows drift across the wheat fields as summer rain approaches from the western hills.
A ceramic bowl cools beside the window while steam rises from freshly brewed tea.
The choir practices its final verse beneath the vaulted ceiling before the evening performance.
